name: settings-group-tint
description: The page applies the settings of the start document of a project and sends the theme and the menu language to the host; a write of group.tint that is no integer from 0 to 100 is refused without a call.
reason: The calls setTheme and setMenuLanguage apply to the window of the native host, which the Go producer does not run (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
